_readme: How the battle screen dresses the board (presentation only; never read by the battle). Backdrops: the painted backdrops of each region and arena size (several per arena; each ArtKey once; a region with battle layouts has exactly one layout per backdrop in content/data/Encounters/battle-layouts.json, whose obstacles are painted on it, and a battle draws its own layout's backdrop), the RegionArt pattern of enemy-library.json (RegionId, a regions.json id, and ArtKey, a sprite's ArtKey in content/art/pixel/pixel-art-manifest.json: backdrop/<region>/<id>/<arena>), plus Arena (Small 5x7, Medium 8x11, Large 11x15) and BoardRect: where the arena's tiles box (HexLayout.BoardBounds) lies in the image, as fractions of the image (X, Y from its top-left, Width, Height). The rest of the image is decorative margin that runs under the HUD to the canvas edges; the images are 9:16 and, at the fit-all camera view, cover the 1080x1920 canvas plus a 4% bleed on every side (room for the screen shake). A region and arena with no entry draws the pixel-tile board. Board: the overlays drawn over a backdrop, in this order, under the units: the hex grid (GridColor, a palette char; GridAlpha 0-1; GridWidth in canvas px, 0.5-6), then the deployment-zone tints (PlayerZoneColor/Alpha, EnemyZoneColor/Alpha), HudScrimAlpha, the dark scrim behind the HUD bands, ObstacleOutlineColor/Alpha (a faint outline on obstacle hexes; off, alpha 0, by default: the painted obstacle is the read) and MoveReachColor/Alpha (the movement preview between turns: the tiles the next unit could move to). SkillIcons: how every skill icon is framed in the HUD (the skill strip, the skill detail card and the turn order's now-acting badge): layers back to front, each centred in the icon's box, the rarity's Ring (RingScale of the box), the icon (IconScale; the skill's ArtKey), the round Frame (FrameScale); Frame and each Ring are sprites' ArtKeys (painted slots), a rarity may Tint its ring (a palette char). A skill's rarity: its Overrides entry (by the skill's icon ArtKey), else BeastRarity / AvatarRarity / EnemyRarity by where it comes from. The art slots and exact sizes: docs/art/hollow-art-slots.md. Rules: BeastCraft.Presentation.Art.BattleArtValidator.
